name: Virginia Environmental Endowment: Virginia Program
summary: Twice-yearly grants for projects in Virginia that improve local rivers and water quality, restore the Chesapeake Bay, and conserve large landscapes, riparian buffers and headwater streams. Land purchases are not funded.
reporting: Grantees report on progress quarterly, with a final report including financials at the end of the project.

calls.label: June 15 and December 1 rounds

status.quote: Applications are accepted biannually for Virginia Program grants, with deadlines of June 15th and December 1st.

recurring.quote: Proposals must be received by VEE at info@vee.org by 5 p.m. (ET) on June 15 for the June round and December 1 for the December round.

calls.recurring: Proposals are due by 5 p.m. ET on June 15 and December 1 each year; a weekend or holiday moves it to the next business day.

geography.quote: Improve local rivers and protect water quality throughout Virginia

access.quote: Does VEE accept unsolicited proposals? Yes, but all prospective grantees are encouraged to submit applications that are consistent with VEE's priorities

window.quote: Applications are accepted biannually for Virginia Program grants, with deadlines of June 15th and December 1st.

reporting.quote: In general, grantees report on progress quarterly. Grant funds are released after reports are submitted and reviewed. A final report is due at the end of the project with greater detail and financial reports.
